content.comment_body: Are you able to ping the [product_name] Communication Module?

Hello [user_name], Before continuing, please clarify the following: Is your computer directly connected to the [product_name] Communication Module? Are both your [product_name] Communication Module and computer also connected to the [product_name] Basis Module?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing issues with establishing network communication between a computer and the [product_name] Communication Module. Discussion revolves around confirming how the devices are connected and whether basic steps such as pinging the module succeed, suggesting possible network setup or configuration issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for stable and direct network communication between their computer and the [product_name] Communication Module, along with simple instructions for troubleshooting connectivity.
